title: Fast field arithmetic for 127014 information charts

claims.statement: For the binary encoder (a,b,ab,a^3+lambda*b^3) in the fixed degree-ten field extension and the stated decoder with 127014 information charts, the average block error for a uniform 1000-bit message on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 55632661054900983/1000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check the degree-50 base field and its degree-ten extension, exact admitted volume and error, operation and memory bounds, and sample ordinary and split chart identities and direction updates. Check sample interpolation products and packed slices.
